summary: Built a routed, highly available PostgreSQL 16 service. node2 was the initial primary, node3/node4 were streaming replicas, appdb replicated successfully, primary failure preserved writes, recovered nodes rejoined automatically, and all four nodes passed sequential restart recovery. The current healthy leader is node3 after the failover tests.
actions_performed: Configured and persisted VyOS routing between lan-a and lan-b on node1.
Configured persistent private-LAN routes on node2, node3, and node4.
Deployed a three-member etcd quorum and Patroni-managed PostgreSQL cluster.
Created appdb and verified replication and single-primary write enforcement.
Stopped node2's database stack, verified automatic promotion and continued writes, then restored node2 and verified automatic rejoin.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually, verifying changed boot IDs and full recovery after each.
Verified the final cluster has one leader, two zero-lag streaming replicas, healthy DCS quorum, and replicated post-restart data.

evidence.summary: node1 has persisted addresses on both LANs, and database-node routes select their private NIC and VyOS gateway.

evidence.requirement: Initial primary on node2 with node3/node4 streaming replicas
evidence.summary: node2 bootstrapped writable while node3 and node4 joined as streaming replicas with the same database system identifier.

evidence.requirement: Create and replicate appdb with exactly one writable primary
evidence.summary: appdb and its marker row appeared on all members; both replicas rejected direct INSERT operations.

evidence.requirement: Remain writable with one database node unavailable
evidence.summary: With node2's PostgreSQL and etcd services stopped, node3 promoted, accepted a new appdb row, and replicated it to read-only node4.

evidence.requirement: Automatically return recovered nodes to service
evidence.summary: Restored node2 automatically rewound and rejoined on the new timeline as a zero-lag streaming replica with the outage write present.
Captured healthy routing and boot ID, received reboot acknowledgement, observed a changed boot ID, and verified restored VyOS configuration, LAN reachability, and database-cluster health.
Captured healthy replica state and boot ID, acknowledged reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified private routing, etcd, Patroni, appdb, and streaming membership recovered.
Captured healthy leader state and boot ID, acknowledged reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified automatic failover plus node3's streaming-replica recovery and full quorum.
Captured healthy leader state and boot ID, acknowledged reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified node4 returned as a streaming replica with intact appdb data.

All three DCS endpoints are healthy; node3 is the sole primary endpoint, node2/node4 return non-primary status and reject writes, both replicas stream at zero lag, and all members contain the three expected appdb markers.
